concept: 1978 VHS ritual in the language of The Holy Mountain: in a white temple, a blob of raw flesh with many long thin arms splits open like a spiked red flower on a white altar and a white dove sits in its wound, blood running down the stone; hooded figures kneel on the white steps with their backs to us; a small 117 in dripping blood on the bare wall
audio_source: original sound made locally: synthesized organ, bells and noise with Windows text-to-speech voices; no third-party audio
